# Emily & Rachel Lynde

- [Emily](../character/emily.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — struck up a lifelong friendship · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's long-lost wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived at his house. The news spreads quickly through the neighborhood, with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigating the situation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who admits he is glad his wife has returned and prepares to explain their past separation.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) how he and his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), originally separated over housecleaning habits and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), leading to their eventual reconciliation. [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns and warmly welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md), after which [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) are present.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal
